metadata.rules_text:
- Model consistently overestimates prices in early forecast windows, especially after recent spikes; apply downward bias correction for first 5–7 days.
- After a price spike, model tends to overshoot and fail to correct quickly; reduce forecast slope by 10–15% in the 3–7 day window post-spike.
- When sentiment is neutral (all 0.00), model exhibits strong mean-reversion bias — forecast should be anchored to recent 7-day average rather than 30-day trend.
- If true outcome shows sharp reversal from high to low, model often fails to recognize it; add a 2–3 day lag correction for downward reversals.
- In absence of sentiment signals, model overconfidently assumes continuation of prior trend; reduce forecast volatility by 20–30% for 10+ day horizons.
- For 30-day forecasts, model frequently misses large downward corrections; apply a 5–10% downward adjustment if true outcome drops below 30% of 30-day moving average.
